facts.material: industrial air handling unit with motor-driven fans, fixed wetted media, water system and controls
facts.function: cooling air by direct evaporation, no refrigeration; humidity change only incidental

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 8479 names evaporative air coolers; heading 8415 requires elements for changing temperature and humidity (air conditioning machines), which these units expressly are not
GRI 6: 8479.60 evaporative air coolers, single line

rejected_alternatives.reason: air conditioning machines not incorporating refrigeration; the unit is not designed to change humidity, cooling is evaporative
central station air handlers incorporating a refrigerating unit; no refrigeration here
fans are only a component; principal function is evaporative cooling

classification.rationale: Principal function is cooling by direct evaporation through wetted media, matching heading 8479 evaporative air coolers. Air handling rulings found (N326143, N328579) involved refrigeration or dehumidification and differ on facts, so are not cited.
